summary: Staff pharmacist with a Doctor of Pharmacy and nine years of retail pharmacy experience in a high-volume setting, managing ancillary staff and fulfilling more than 1,500 prescriptions weekly. Core work includes prescription dispensing and compounding, drug utilization review, drug interaction assessment, and patient counselling on dosage, side effects and OTC products. Also experienced in insurance billing and reimbursement coordination, inventory management, and controlled-substance record keeping, with an earlier background in electronics engineering and laboratory teaching. Seeking to transition into hospital clinical pharmacy.
